objective: Determine reproducibly and fail-closed whether frozen QOS selector alpha survives survivorship, PIT leakage, universe bias and selection bias.

phase_1b.rule: Cross-reconcile only hash-sealed historical evidence. Do not mutate or silently substitute into the frozen current V2A source cascade.

phase_2.universe: CoinMarketCap historical month-end top 150 from 2020-06-30 through 2026-07-31
phase_2.minimum_snapshot_rule: Report every snapshot; never relabel mean coverage as complete per-snapshot coverage.

phase_3_preregistration.comparison_calendar: exact 201 week_end values in canonical WEEKLY_BASKETS_STRICT.csv
phase_3_preregistration.terminal_return_application: Flat inside each signal interval and apply the assigned terminal return on the final included observation; preserve all other canonical daily returns.
phase_3_preregistration.baseline_terminal_weighting: missing structural membership count divided by canonical terminal available covered count plus missing structural membership count
phase_3_preregistration.empirical_reference_pool: Only physically covered assets with non-missing daily returns on every canonical included date in the signal interval.

scenarios.missing_return_rule: No synthetic insertion; reproduce canonical economics byte-for-number.

scenarios.interpretation: Selector-favourable upper bound: every missing asset loses 50% and is never selected.
Selector-favourable upper bound: every missing asset loses 80% and is never selected.
Conceptual delisting/terminal-loss bound, not an observed delisting ledger.

scenarios.missing_return_rule: minimum contemporaneous covered asset terminal return
scenarios.interpretation: All missing assets rank below the selector cutoff; selection-favourable bound.
Neutral missingness control; report median, 5th/95th percentiles and probability of positive direct alpha.

scenarios.missing_return_rule: best contemporaneous covered return enters the baseline and worst enters every feasible selector slot
best contemporaneous covered return enters the shared baseline only in canonical periods where either frozen selector has positive selector-minus-baseline contribution
scenarios.interpretation: Tests whether omitted winners in apparent contribution periods erase the selector result.

loss_grid.purpose: Locate any selector-favourable baseline-only sign-change threshold; do not tune or promote from it.

terminal_stop_rule: If observed incremental alpha is non-positive, any plausible sensitivity removes it, coverage is materially insufficient, leakage is detected, or ablation/replication fails, close the hypothesis without retune and do not execute later phases.
